lines.en: Lesson 45
lines.zh: 第45课

lines.en: Of men and galaxies
lines.zh: 人类与星系

lines.en: What is the most influential factor in any human society?
lines.zh: 在任何人类社会中，最具影响力的因素是什么？

lines.en: In man's early days, competition with other creatures must have been critical.
lines.zh: 在人类早期，与其他生物的竞争一定是至关重要的。

lines.en: But this phase of our development is now finished.
lines.zh: 但我们发展的这个阶段现在已经结束了。

lines.en: Indeed, we lack practice and experience nowadays in dealing with primitive conditions.
lines.zh: 事实上，我们现在缺乏处理原始条件的实践和经验。

lines.en: I am sure that, without modern weapons,
lines.zh: 我确信，如果没有现代武器，

lines.en: I would make a very poor show of disputing the ownership of a cave with a bear, and in this I do not think that I stand alone.
lines.zh: 我在与熊争夺洞穴所有权方面会表现得很糟糕，而且我认为我并非孤身一人。

lines.en: The last creature to compete with man was the mosquito.
lines.zh: 最后一种与人类竞争的生物是蚊子。

lines.en: But even the mosquito has been subdued by attention to drainage and by chemical sprays.
lines.zh: 但即使是蚊子也因对排水的重视和化学喷雾而被制服了。

lines.en: Competition between ourselves, person against person,
lines.zh: 我们彼此之间的竞争，人与人之间，

lines.en: community against community, still persists, however; and it is as fierce as it ever was.
lines.zh: 社群与社群之间，仍然存在；而且它和以往一样激烈。

lines.en: But the competition of man against man is not the simple process envisioned in biology.
lines.zh: 但人与人之间的竞争并不是生物学中设想的简单过程。

lines.en: It is not a simple competition for a fixed amount of food determined by the physical environment,
lines.zh: 这不是一种由物理环境决定的对固定数量食物的简单竞争，

lines.en: because the environment that determines our evolution is no longer essentially physical.
lines.zh: 因为决定我们进化的环境本质上不再是物理的了。

lines.en: Our environment is chiefly conditoned by the things we believe.
lines.zh: 我们的环境主要由我们所相信的事物所决定。

lines.en: Morocco and California are bits of the Earth in very similar latitudes,
lines.zh: 摩洛哥和加利福尼亚是地球上纬度非常相似的两个地方，

lines.en: both on the west coasts of continents with similar climates, and probably with rather similar natural resources.
lines.zh: 都位于大陆西海岸，气候相似，而且可能拥有相当相似的自然资源。

lines.en: Yet their present development is wholly different,
lines.zh: 然而，它们目前的发展却截然不同，

lines.en: not so much because of different people even,
lines.zh: 甚至不是因为不同的人，

lines.en: but because of the different thoughts that exist in the minds of their inhabitants.
lines.zh: 而是因为其居民心中存在的不同思想。

lines.en: This is the point I wish to emphasize.
lines.zh: 这就是我希望强调的重点。

lines.en: The most important factor in our environment is the state of our own minds.
lines.zh: 我们环境中最重要的因素是我们自己的心智状态。

lines.en: It is well known that where the white man has invaded a primitive culture,
lines.zh: 众所周知，当白人侵入原始文化时，

lines.en: the most destructive effects have come not from physical weapons but from ideas.
lines.zh: 最具破坏性的影响并非来自实体武器，而是来自思想。

lines.en: Ideas are dangerous.
lines.zh: 思想是危险的。

lines.en: The Holy Office knew this full well when it caused heretics to be burned in days gone by.
lines.zh: 过去的异端裁判所对此心知肚明，因为它曾将异教徒烧死。

lines.en: Indeed, the concept of free speech only exists in our modern society because when you are inside a community,
lines.zh: 事实上，言论自由的概念之所以存在于我们的现代社会，是因为当你身处一个社群中时，

lines.en: you are conditioned by the conventions of the community to such a degree that it is very difficult to conceive of anything really destructive.
lines.zh: 你被社群的习俗所制约，以至于很难构想出任何真正具有破坏性的事物。

lines.en: It is only someone looking on from outside that can inject the dangerous thoughts.
lines.zh: 只有旁观者才能注入危险的思想。

lines.en: I do not doubt that it would be possible to inject ideas into the modern world that would utterly destroy us.
lines.zh: 我不怀疑有可能向现代世界注入彻底摧毁我们的思想。

lines.en: I would like to give you an example, but fortunately I cannot do so.
lines.zh: 我想给你们举个例子，但幸运的是我不能。

lines.en: Perhaps it will suffice to mention the nuclear bomb.
lines.zh: 也许提到核弹就足够了。

lines.en: Imagine the effect on a reasonably advanced technological society,
lines.zh: 想象一下，对一个相当先进的科技社会，

lines.en: one that still does not possess the bomb, of making it aware of the possibility, of supplying suffcient details to enable the thing to be constructed.
lines.zh: 一个尚未拥有核弹的社会，如果让它意识到可能性，并提供足够的细节使其能够被建造出来，那会产生什么影响。

lines.en: 20 or 30 pages of information handed to any of the major world powers around the year 1925,
lines.zh: 1925年左右，将20或30页信息交给任何一个世界主要大国，

lines.en: would have been sufficient to change the course of world history.
lines.zh: 足以改变世界历史的进程。

lines.en: It is a strange thought, but I believe a correct one,
lines.zh: 这是一个奇怪的想法，但我相信它是正确的，

lines.en: that twenty or thirty pages of ideas and information would be capable of turning the present-day world upside down, or even destroying it.
lines.zh: 即二三十页的思想和信息就足以颠覆当今世界，甚至摧毁它。

lines.en: I have often tried to conceive of what those pages might contain,
lines.zh: 我曾多次试图构想那些页面可能包含什么，

lines.en: but of course I cannot do so because I am a prisoner of the present-day world, just as all of you are.
lines.zh: 但我当然做不到，因为我是当今世界的囚徒，就像你们所有人一样。

lines.en: We cannot think outside the particular patterns that our brains are conditioned to, or,
lines.zh: 我们无法跳出我们大脑被制约的特定模式进行思考，或者说，

lines.en: to be more accurate we can think only a very little way outside and then only if we are very original.
lines.zh: 更准确地说，我们只能稍微跳出一点，而且只有当我们非常具有原创性时才能做到。
